title: Odyssey Full Curriculum Campaign
intro: Every concept has five games: Intro (what) → When (timing) → How (procedure) → Trap (misuse) → Mastery (pressure). Wrong = RED + why. Right = unlock next. Linear spine; progress always saves.
ethics: Linear mastery path for learning integrity. No FOMO punishment — progress saves; missing a day never costs.

challenges.title: 1. What is SAP BTP?
challenges.brief: Curriculum 1/785 · btp-what · intro. The platform layer where you build, integrate, extend, and operate intelligent enterprise apps beside SAP systems of record.

steps.title: Recognize the idea
steps.teach: SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) is SAP’s cloud platform for application development, integration, data & analytics, automation, and AI — typically used beside S/4HANA and other systems of record. Think of three layers: 1) Systems of record (S/4, success factors, etc.) hold
